purpose: Consumed by Scripts/release_limestone_textures_v2.py. Imports the authored Jerusalem limestone (meleke) ashlar set V2 (Scripts/create_limestone_textures_v2.py -> SourceAssets/material-review/LimestoneV2/), creates TWO NEW material instances parented on the existing limestone instances, and reassigns every static-mesh material slot whose effective material is MI_PBR_LimestoneAshlar / MI_PBR_LimestoneTrim to the new instances at the COMPONENT OVERRIDE level. Nothing shared is edited: not M_PBR_Tiled, not the nine repaired PBR instances (a previous pass flattened the frieze relief by editing a shared parent). Every number here is read back numerically; nothing claims visual acceptance.
diagnosisAnswered: release_lighting_v3.spec.json diagnosis.textureMeasured: sandstone_blocks_08 albedo per-channel std 0.021 (R p5-p95 0.62-0.68), normal xy deviation p95 0.09, roughness 0.50 uniform. The V2 set's measured statistics are in SourceAssets/material-review/LimestoneV2/manifest.json and are copied into the import receipt.

Normal.why: The maps encode normalize(-dh/du, -dh/dv, 1) with v = image row; M_PBR_Tiled adds decoded (R,G) along world (u,v) axes, so no green flip (same as the set being replaced, release_pbr_architecture.spec.json textures.normal.flipGreenChannel=false).

ARM.channels: R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (0)

whyScalarsExplicit: The new instances override every scalar and the Tint themselves, so a later change on the parent (lighting-v3 variant A proposes NormalStrength 2.5 / RoughnessScale 1.6 on MI_PBR_LimestoneAshlar to compensate for the WEAK old maps) cannot double-apply to maps that already carry physical relief and 0.55-0.85 roughness. TilingCm stays 300 so course lines keep falling on world-Z multiples of 50 cm (Ashlar) / 37.5 cm (Trim). Trim lightness is baked into its albedo, so its Tint is neutral instead of the parent's 1.08/1.06/1.02.

countPolicy.why: A different count means the scene moved since the inventory; look before reassigning.

nanite.why: The nine repaired instances persist explicit Nanite usage overrides (release_nanite_instance_usage.py); 7632 of 7767 mesh components are Nanite. The new children set and read back the same override so no runtime 'missing usage flag Nanite' returns.

commandlet.note: Strictly serial. Check Get-Process UnrealEditor,UnrealEditor-Cmd first. Unique -abslog per run. -nullrhi is fine for import/apply/revert/verify (no shader evidence is claimed); a real-RHI PIE capture (lighting_capture_v3.py views) is the visual review.

limitations: Procedural authored set, not a photographic scan of meleke; the statistics prove contrast and relief exist, not that it looks right. Visual acceptance is the coordinator's real-RHI capture.
Course lines are world-aligned by the triplanar master, so every wall shares the same course levels (like real coursed ashlar); block boundaries do not know where a real wall ends.
Revert restores the map's slot overrides; the imported textures and the two new instances stay on disk (unreferenced) unless removed deliberately.
